name: Grafana Cloud Logs
summary: Grafana Cloud Logs is a hosted service built on Grafana Loki, which indexes labels rather than the full text of each line. The free plan includes 50 GB of logs a month with 14-day retention. Pro adds a $19 monthly platform fee and 30-day retention, with usage billed per GB.

facts.text: An agent such as Grafana Alloy scrapes logs, attaches labels to group them into streams, and pushes them to Loki over an HTTP API. Logs are queried with LogQL.
In Loki, retention is off by default and logs are kept indefinitely until the compactor is configured. Retention can be set globally, per stream by label selector, or per tenant.
Loki alerting rules use the same format as Prometheus alerting rules, with LogQL as the expression language.
The pricing page does not state alerting or single sign-on limits for the Free and Pro logs plans.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 50 GB of logs a month, 14-day retention, community support

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Platform fee. 50 GB of logs included, then pay as you go with 30-day retention and 8x5 email support

hiddenCosts: Beyond the included 50 GB, Pro logs start at $0.05 per GB for processing, $0.40 per GB for writing and $0.10 per GB for retaining. Volume discounts apply as usage grows.
Enterprise offers custom retention, and the pricing page does not list a price.
